units.text: I set up signed firmware images and a staged rollout plan, starting with 10 test devices and widening to 50 before the full fleet. All 400 sensors were updated remotely without any site visits.
I organised the annual safety training day for 60 employees, booking the trainers and arranging lunch for everyone.
I built an hourly Python check that compared expected and received readings for each device.
It revealed 3 gateways with wrong clock settings, and after I fixed them, lost readings stayed below 0.5%.
